changed.what: Requests S75/S81 settled by their own second option: section 7 now says g0_doctrine is one of the crate's own check targets in BD-025's sense (beside registry_check and pilot_register), not a seventh tier target. It runs no gate entry or row, `-- d2` is a libtest name filter, scripts run it with e2e_cmd and not e2e_tier, and its receipt carries tier G0. The reason is stated (the tier runner selects only by gate, row, site or milestone), and the section lists which bead adds each d* family. Other fixes: the scratch-tree override now uses FROB_LINT_ROOT, where before the e2e said 'registry path overridden' with no mechanism behind it. The e2e step that compared against `frob doctor`'s registry hash could never pass, because doctor's registries section covers registries/ only and not the crate register; it is replaced by checks that the receipt hash matches and that the hash depends on content only. The `pilot` field is now a list whose entries must exist in pilots.toml, because C-06 has two records. The theorem-card list (N12-06 depends on this bead through SPEC-C-14) is read when present and reported pending before then. Added deps for what the test reads: N32a-02 (verbs.toml), N40-01 (gates.toml), N38a-12 (KA parser) and N38a-02 (receipt writer).

This bead claimed to register four 'proposed' relation mutations as its own controls, but N38a-15 already registers MR-C01..MR-C11, each with its own mutation, and the rule is one control per mutation. The pinned table now names each registry row, its owner and due milestone (MR-C01..C05, MR-C11, MR-14/25/28/38/41, all due M2) and uses the registries' mutation text; the bead registers no relation or control. Added a grace rule for relations: they land at M2, so without it an M1 check would fail on a correct tree. Pinned rows are matched by identifier, because MR-38's source names no construction. `generated_from` is not in N38a-14's schema, so it is marked as a requested optional field and reported pending. The D-9 controls now follow the grace rule and name their planting beads and milestones. KA-049's joint rates and tool velocity are added, since the power figure needs them. The e2e called g3_metamorphic with construction ids as filters, which is not a valid filter, and measured GATE-GAUNT-03, which is N38a-19's job. It now runs only g0_doctrine d4/d9, the plants via FROB_LINT_ROOT and the two grace-rule plants. Planted negatives are due at or before FROB_MILESTONE. New unit test d4_relation_grace. N38a-15 and N38a-19 added to related.
In the per-verb invocation sweep, each run-kind verb now carries its own `--key "$(e2e_key <verb>)"` (drift 5), so each output is computed fresh and not read back from a stored receipt.

Added dep N26a-23, the lane firewall that raises the FROB-REF-560 the script asserts. The script's `…` now spells out the inputs that VERBS-nemesis requires: candidate and --task; --legality and --budget for search; --tier batch-cpu and --target for bound, where --tier has no default. N26a-23 is named in Out.

The bead said row C-06's `pilot` names PILOT-C-06 and that this 'resolves to both' records, but no such record exists and nothing resolves it. The field is now a list holding PILOT-C-06-law and PILOT-C-06-reuse, matching the list form in N10a-01.

The referee `sim run` had no design and no key, so the A/A potency pair would have read one stored receipt twice. It now takes the frozen model as its positional design, plus --seconds, --seed and a distinct --key per robot, trial and seed; the A/A trials run under two distinct keys. The protocol now fixes a simulated time limit for the traverse, because a traverse trial previously had no end.

Request S76 applied: step 3d runs `FROB_TEST_SEED=<seed> cargo test … --test <tier> -- KA-037` through e2e_tier, with the bare row id as the filter, plus the gauntlet-mutations build for the controls. Step 2b now treats items N10a-05 reports pending as not yet due, and names the pinned relations by registry id, all due M2. The MR-C01 negative control is planted on a scratch copy whose due is set to the milestone under review. The C-06 pilot ids are corrected in the map and the due lists. The pilots whose records the M1 run needs (N21a-13, N13-27, N10a-15, N10a-18, N10a-19, N10a-20) move from related to deps, as in the sibling N10b-19; none depends on this bead. A Considerations line gives the reason.

Request H-owners-1 applied: KA-037 and KA-038 run under g1_known_answers and KA-039, a G0 row, under g0_laws, through e2e_tier with the seed and the mutation build. Request S23 applied: `frob analyze mobility <fixture> --json` takes the design positionally (no --design flag) and is logged pending until BD-101. The asserts now follow the row's outputs: rank mobility 1, the Grübler count (0 and −2), and `lattice` reading not-run on the default build or decided(1)/undecided from M3. Before, the e2e asserted a 'method lattice or rank' that the verb does not report.
`analyze workspace` with 'a required foot height' named no option. It now uses the row's `--target-step-height <h>` at a reachable height and asserts the solution count of the surviving branches.

`sim run --tier referee` had no design and no key, and `telemetry energy` had no run. Both now have them: the motor–gear–link fixture as the positional design, --seconds, --seed and --key spec-c12-mgl, then `telemetry energy <run>` on the returned run id.

The run-kind verbs `sim run` and `control synth` had no design and no key (drift 5). They now take templates/quad-mammal as the positional design, plus --seconds, --seed and a distinct --key each; `control estimate <run>` reads the returned run id.

Both `eval compare` refusal calls now carry distinct --key values, because eval.compare is a run verb (VERBS-eval) and each refusal must be computed separately. study.plan is key_optional and eval.preanalyze is a read verb, so neither needed a change.

requests.what: List g0_doctrine (N10a-01 §7: the doctrine families d1..d19 written by N10a-01..09) among the crate check targets that ADR-GAUNT-01 and lint rule 5 accept, beside registry_check, no_conformance_command, binaries_declared and pilot_register. It is a check target and not a seventh tier. Slice requests S75/S81 settled on that option and not on moving d2_* into g0_laws, because the tier runner selects only by gate, row, site or milestone.

The register's `pilot` field is now a list (N10a-01), because C-06 has two records (PILOT-C-06-law, PILOT-C-06-reuse; N10a-14). The d10 check that reads it should accept a list, require it non-empty when the tier contains F or M, and require every entry to exist in pilots.toml.

Add an optional `generated_from = "C-nn.Sk"` field to the relation record. N10a-05's check C uses it to show that relations are generated from contract statements, and reports pending until the field exists.

MR-38's `source` reads 'Kernel rewrites, INV-SPARK-09' and names no construction, although N10a-05 pins it to C-14 (the class-E rule). Consider adding C-14 to its source so that the general source-names-construction rule holds without the pin.

Reconcile mechanisms: N10a-01 §6's law-suite convention compiles mutants under a cargo feature `controls` and selects them by NC id, while N38b-04 uses per-control `nc-<nnnn>` features under `gauntlet-mutations`. All forty SPEC beads run `--features controls`. Either state that the law-suite feature maps to the nc-* features, or have N10a-01 adopt them (a request to N10a-01 and BD-025 together).
